undergraduate_first_steps.title: Identify your cohort’s requirements
undergraduate_first_steps.why: Major requirements and general education rules vary by entry year; an attractive roadmap is not a graduation audit.

undergraduate_first_steps.title: Check required prerequisites before choosing advanced courses
undergraduate_first_steps.why: A course can be useful preparation without being a compulsory prerequisite. Keep those relationships distinct.

undergraduate_first_steps.title: Check the actual semester offering and course code
undergraduate_first_steps.why: The revised guide changes some recommended semesters and offerings. Cross-listed course codes can count differently.

undergraduate_first_steps.title: Find the current registration and over-quota notice
undergraduate_first_steps.why: Each semester has its own dates and request process. September 2026 deadlines must not be reused.

undergraduate_first_steps.title: Understand the graduation project early
undergraduate_first_steps.why: Choosing a professor, submitting the poster, presenting and getting the thesis signed are separate steps.

graduate_first_steps.title: Distinguish coursework completion from graduation
graduate_first_steps.why: 수료 and graduation are different milestones; the university simulator may omit ECE requirements.

graduate_first_steps.title: Check the qualifying exam and required training
graduate_first_steps.why: Eligibility depends on programme, semesters, eligible credits and the current rule; English-taught coursework alone does not prove exemption.

graduate_first_steps.title: If registered for Thesis Research, check its confirmation requirement
graduate_first_steps.why: The historical example requires both an online form and signed paper, with exceptions for different course professors and two sections.

graduate_first_steps.title: Plan thesis review and publication evidence
graduate_first_steps.why: Current rules, publication evidence, office documents and library upload are distinct requirements.
